Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

plan — an idea about what you will do. Example: My plan is to study next year.
tomorrow — the day after today. Example: Tomorrow I am going to buy a ticket.
next week — the week after this one. Example: Next week I am going to travel.
weekend — Saturday and Sunday. Example: At the weekend I am going to meet friends.
visit — to go to see a person or place. Example: I am going to visit my family.
travel — to go from one place to another. Example: Travel is easier with English.
meet — to come together with someone. Example: We are going to meet at eight.
buy — to get something with money. Example: I am going to buy a ticket.
future — the time after now. Example: In the future I want to travel.
going to — used for future plans. Example: I am going to travel next week.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I am going to ...
• We are going to ...
• What are you going to do?
• Next week ...
• At the weekend ...

Grammar focus: Be going to for future plans.
Use be going to for all future plans: I am going to visit my family tomorrow. We are going to meet at the weekend.
